subtitle: Lesson 17 · Power BI for Data Scientists

caption: Import: fast, full-featured, a snapshot. DirectQuery: live, slower.

eyebrow: Shape it in SQL, load a small result
code:
SELECT region,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       AVG(CAST(churned AS float)) AS churn_rate
FROM dbo.customers
GROUP BY region;
caption: Paste into Advanced options > SQL statement.
Point Power BI at your local Python home directory.
Every pandas DataFrame your script creates becomes a table.

eyebrow: Or inside Power Query: Transform > Run Python script
code:
q1, q3 = dataset["total_spend"].quantile(
    [0.25, 0.75])
upper = q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1)
dataset["spend_flag"] = \
    dataset["total_spend"] > upper
caption: The loaded table arrives as a DataFrame named dataset.
